BiblicalUsage: A club is a weapon Leviathan laughs at. Darts are counted as stubble to him, and he laughs at the shaking of a spear, and the club is one of the weapons that cannot touch him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the joke is at human strength's expense: the best weapons men carry are stubble to the creature God made.
